annotations.title: Turn anomaly detection on or off

description: Use this when the user wants FlareWarden to alert on unusual response times of a site, or unusual run times of a cron job, or to stop doing so or change how sensitive it is. Returns whether it is on, its sensitivity, and its recent anomalies. Turning it on costs one monitor; turning it off frees it. It learns for 3 days before reporting. Not for ordinary up or down alerts, which every monitor sends.

check.description: A cron job on the site, by id or name; leave out for the site's response times.

enabled.description: True to turn it on (or change sensitivity), false to turn it off.

site.description: The site, by id, name or part of its URL.

name: set_anomaly_detection
title: Turn anomaly detection on or off
